id: title:jonmcwest:time cyclotron worker phases and job lateness

review.posthog_relevance: Adds Prometheus-compatible metrics to track worker phase durations, job scheduling lateness, and flush operation durations, allowing PostHog to observe and diagnose performance bottlenecks in the CDP worker and HogFunction monitoring components.
review.reason: The change adds three specific Prometheus-compatible Histogram metrics with defined buckets and labels. P1.F1.H3 adds a timer for worker invocation phases, P1.F2.H3 adds a timer for job scheduling lateness, and P1.F3.H2 adds a timer for flush operations. These are substantive, bounded improvements to observability and reliability diagnostics. The implementation demonstrates the use
review.uncertainty: While the implementation of the metrics is present, the complete surrounding context and configuration are not fully established, and the actual benefit of these metrics is not independently verified. No tier assignment is made.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the complete implementation of the timer usage or the complete context of the surrounding class, but the added lines are sufficient to establish the presence of the metric and its usage. No tier assignment is made.

observations.behavior: Adds a Histogram named cdp_cyclotron_worker_phase_duration_seconds with specific buckets and label names, and uses it to start and end timers around invocations and background tasks.
observations.code_quote: const endInvocations = cyclotronWorkerPhaseDuration.startTimer({ queue: this.queue, phase: 'invocations' })
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a Prometheus-compatible metric to track the wall time of worker phases, allowing PostHog to observe worker performance and identify stalls or slow phases.

observations.behavior: Adds a Histogram named cdp_cyclotron_job_lateness_seconds and observes the lateness of jobs dequeued from the queue.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a Prometheus-compatible metric to track the lateness of jobs, allowing PostHog to observe queue performance and identify scheduling delays.

observations.behavior: Adds a Histogram named cdp_hog_function_monitoring_flush_duration_seconds and uses it to start and end timers around the flush operation.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a Prometheus-compatible metric to track the wall time of flushing queued app metrics and log entries, allowing PostHog to observe flush performance.
